scope: Real MuJoCo WASM, XML and package round-trips, protocol semantics, coordinate mathematics; X_ITE adapter field calls tested with a deliberately substituted browser port, not a GPU.

checks.name: real engine initializes curated model and stable body mappings
basis transform is invertible and preserves proper orientation
forward and inverse target agree on elbow-positive branch
target command reaches controller and real touch returns to snapshot
authored geometry and mass compile into the named MuJoCo model
invalid recipe and stale revision preserve physical state
duplicate commands are idempotent; identifier conflicts are rejected
protocol rejects unknown type, malformed target and invalid transport
standard X3D XML round-trips the declared physical profile

warnings: Imported X3D is normalized to this profile. Only declared physical annotations, obstacle position/radius and joint targets are read; other presentation edits are reported as outside the importer contract.
Serialized body poses, sensor values and drag state are observations only; import resets physics to home.

checks.name: external X3D annotation and obstacle edits drive physical recompilation
importer rejects scripts, URLs, DTDs, duplicate IDs and wrong profiles
experiment package is internally consistent and round-trips
tampered package MJCF is rejected rather than silently substituted
X_ITE adapter writes named transforms and physical sensor metadata
X3D drag callback submits a controller target to the actual engine
high-precision target metadata survives X3D and package round-trip
obstacle drag stages then commits an authored physical edit
adapter disposal removes all field callbacks
emitted node fields exist in the official X3D 4.0 UOM

details.notClaimed: Full ISO schema validation or native RigidBodyPhysics conformance
